messages:
Alyssa: Quick q — compliance asked for routing policy audit export: need to show "who" changed policy, the before/after, and the effective rollout. Thoughts on including full diffs in the NDJSON or only a compact summary?
Matt: prefer compact for large orgs. full diffs blow up size. maybe compact + link to presigned full bundle
Kevin: agree. compact entry could include change_id, actor, timestamp, affected_routes, preview_snippet
Sara: also need tenant_id and op_reason / justification field (if provided). otherwise legal can't map
Liz: can we include actor_ip or session_id? security wants it for anomalous access
Alyssa: security asked for actor_ip too, but that is PII — we might need redaction modes. proposals: none / hashed / full. which is default?
Kevin: default should be hashed for hosted. enterprise can opt-in for full. add export param "pii_mode": "hashed|none|full"
Matt: for NDJSON shape propose:
```
{ "change_id":"c_123", "actor":"alyssa@redwood", "actor_ip_hash":"abcd...", "tenant_id":"t-321", "when": 1733334444, "ops": ["route:update"], "compact_diff":"add route /api/v2 -> model-x" }
```
Sara: +1. Also add "rollout_state" enum: CANARY/ROLLOUT/ROLLEDBACK and "applied_by_commit"
Alyssa: export API: /v1/audit/exports?since=...&pii_mode=hashed&format=ndjson
Liz: what about telemetry? we need export-level metrics for quota and cost: bytes_exported, entries_count, time_to_prepare
Matt: also emit events to telemetry when export is requested and when download completed/failed (for quota and alerting)
Kevin: quota logic: count entries + bytes, but for compact vs full diffs we need weights. propose weights: compact=1, full_diff=5
Sara: edge case: presigned link generation must check entitlements. keep presigned tokens short-lived and log presigned_issued event
Alyssa: UX: Console should show export preview counts and estimated size and quota impact before confirming
Liz: +emoji :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: deploy queued: export-audit-schema-v1 -> staging
Matt: I'll sketch API spec and sample payloads, assign to @Sara for PII policy mapping
Sara: will do. I'll get legal/security on hashed-ip scheme
Alyssa: thanks — can we aim to finalize API shape by EOD Tue? small follow-ups after.
Kevin: noted. adding doc link in thread: https://go/redwood/audit-export-proposal
Alyssa: moving to threads/wg-audit to continue if needed
